title: phoradendron villosum subsp. flavum
intro: Phoradendron villosum subsp. flavum, commonly known as the yellow mistletoe, is a species of parasitic plant that belongs to the family Santalaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and treating digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Phoradendron villosum subsp. flavum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
